unsupported: Dyna Tool & Mold began in 1989 when Randy Damratowski and Darren Yendra each invested $5,000 and borrowed $25,000 to open a shop in Grand Island, Nebraska.
Dyna Tool & Mold serves manufacturers across the Midwest, with a customer base described as diverse but not broken out by sector in public materials.
After the acquisition, leadership highlighted the retention of the existing skilled workforce as a key competitive advantage.
Known for: Quality work at a fair price; On-schedule delivery; Single-source project management from development to completion; Skilled workforce retained after acquisition
